title: Checkpoint after conflict-free decisions without revisiting cleared cycles
narrative: After a decision is settled, the nodes it still conflicts with are revisited, and nodes already visited are not revisited so a circular conflict cannot loop forever. A checkpoint is taken only when the decision has no remaining conflicts; a conflict blocked only by the visited set is reported instead of silently saved. The conflicts themselves are still the write-scope conflicts the product already detects (`fangore_transactional_durable_resume`, `fangore_decision_plane_policy`); this adds the revisit-and-checkpoint rule on top. Tracks MH-SR-08[^insp-sr-08].
